summary: Kerberos (GSSAPI) SPN casefolding causes RBAC principal mismatch in private deployment
description:
Issue summary:
Customers using Kerberos/GSSAPI SSO in private deployment report intermittent 401/403 when calling the Redwood private admin API. The incoming GSSAPI negotiation succeeds at the HTTP layer but RBAC denies the request because the principal string does not match any role bindings.

Impact:
- Customer DataWave Health cannot perform admin operations via service accounts bridged by Kerberos (affects scheduled jobs and human ops).
- Intermittent: some requests succeed and others fail depending on which KDC host canonicalizes the principal.

Environment:
- Private control plane deployed in customer VPC (us-east-1).
- Identity flow: nginx ingress -> identity-proxy (GSSAPI/negotiation) -> internal token exchange -> RBAC enforcement.

Steps to reproduce:
1) kinit -k -t /etc/krb5.keytab host/web01@datwave.EXAMPLE.COM
2) curl --negotiate -u : https://private.redwood.internal/admin/keys -H "Accept: application/json" 
3) Observe 401/403 in ~30% of attempts when KDC returns canonicalized principal with uppercased realm or altered case in SPN.

Expected behavior:
- GSSAPI-authenticated principal should be correctly normalized and matched against RBAC role bindings.

Actual behavior:
- Identity-proxy and RBAC compare the full principal string (primary/component@REALM) verbatim. KDC sometimes returns REALM in uppercase or the component with different case, causing string mismatch and denial.

Relevant logs (redacted):
- identity-proxy: "auth: gssapi OK principal=host/web01@DATWAVE.EXAMPLE.COM"
- rbac: "lookup: principal 'host/web01@datwave.example.com' not in role bindings -> DENY"
- access log: 403 POST /admin/keys  -> X-Auth-Principal: host/web01@DATWAVE.EXAMPLE.COM

Temporary workaround:
- Customer added a permissive role binding for wildcarded principal pattern 'host/web01@*' in their admin RBAC to allow operations while we investigate.

Request/ask:
- Need an SRE/identity owner to validate normalization behavior and propose a safe fix path (proxy-side normalization vs RBAC tolerant matching).
investigation_notes: 03/10: Initial triage by Support; reproduced with customer's test harness. Observed KDC canonicalization variability across KDC cluster.

03/10: Identity-proxy currently forwards the raw principal string from GSSAPI (no normalization). RBAC store uses exact-match keys created from SCIM/IDP provisioning which are lowercase in customer's setup.

03/11: Hypothesis: mismatch arises because customer's provisioning pipeline lowercases principals when creating role bindings, while KDC preserves original case or canonicalizes to uppercase realm (DATWAVE.EXAMPLE.COM).

03/11: Confirmed by enabling debug on identity-proxy: GSSAPI principal differs only by case from SCIM entry in RBAC. Example pair: 'host/web01@DATWAVE.EXAMPLE.COM' vs 'host/web01@datwave.example.com'.
03/11: Quick test: adding a case-insensitive match at RBAC allowed the requests to succeed; indicates root cause is string-comparison policy rather than cryptographic principal mismatch.

03/12: Proposed remediation: add canonicalization layer in identity-proxy to normalize principal to lowercase realm and component before token exchange. Also add unit tests, and a feature flag for rollout.
03/12: Risk assessment: low-risk change if behind feature flag; however must be careful for customers relying on mixed-case principals for legacy reasons. Add opt-in config per private deployment.
Related: INT-3321 contains previous notes on principal normalization for SAML/ODIC flows (reuse patterns).
comments: Support (Aisha Kapoor) 2026-03-10: Customer reported intermittent 401/403 after Kerberos upgrade on their KDC farm. Sent request for krb5.conf and sample access logs.
SRE (Miguel Santos) 2026-03-11: Reproduced locally using customer's keytab. Observed principal case differences. Will open PR to add normalization in identity-proxy behind feature flag.
Customer (DataWave SRE) 2026-03-11: Confirmed wildcard binding workaround works; would prefer a server-side normalization so we don't have to change provisioning.
Security (Priya Raman) 2026-03-12: Confirmed that normalization must be deterministic and logged for audit. Recommend recording original principal in audit events when normalized.

SRE (Miguel Santos) 2026-03-12: Draft PR available: github.com/redwood-inference/identity-proxy/pull/784. Plan: feature-flag rollout to a single private customer cluster, monitor for unexpected allow lists.
next_steps: Finalize PR to add principal normalization (lowercase realm + stable casefold) with feature flag and audit log of original principal.
Coordinate canary rollout with DataWave support window and monitor RBAC denials and audit trails.
Update Kerberos runbook and add a section on recommended KDC canonicalization settings and provisioning guidelines.
Add an automated test to the provisioning pipeline to detect case mismatches between SCIM-created bindings and KDC-returned principals.
